title: Sorting by Subsequences
statementMd:
You are given a sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ consisting of **different** integers. It is required to split this sequence into the **maximum** number of subsequences such that after sorting integers in each of them in increasing order, the total sequence also will be sorted in increasing order.

Sorting integers in a subsequence is a process such that the numbers included in a subsequence are ordered in increasing order, and the numbers which are not included in a subsequence don't change their places.

Every element of the sequence must appear in exactly one subsequence.

## Input

The first line of input data contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the length of the sequence.

The second line of input data contains $*n*$ different integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the elements of the sequence. It is guaranteed that all elements of the sequence are distinct.

## Output

In the first line print the maximum number of subsequences $*k*$, which the original sequence can be split into while fulfilling the requirements.

In the next $*k*$ lines print the description of subsequences in the following format: the number of elements in subsequence $*c*_{*i*}$ ($0 < *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$), then $*c*_{*i*}$ integers $*l*_{1}, *l*_{2}, ..., *l*_{*c*_{*i*}}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$) — indices of these elements in the original sequence.

Indices could be printed in any order. Every index from $1$ to $*n*$ must appear in output **exactly once**.

If there are several possible answers, print any of them.

## Note

In the first sample output:

After sorting the first subsequence we will get sequence $1 2 3 6 5 4$.

Sorting the second subsequence changes nothing.

After sorting the third subsequence we will get sequence $1 2 3 4 5 6$.

Sorting the last subsequence changes nothing.
statementZhMd:
给定一个由**互不相同**的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 组成的序列。现在需要将该序列划分为**尽可能多**个子序列，使得将每个子序列中的整数按升序排序后，整个序列也会按升序排列。

对子序列中的整数进行排序，是指将该子序列所包含的数字按升序排列，而不属于该子序列的数字保持原位置不变。

序列中的每个元素必须恰好出现在一个子序列中。

## 输入格式

输入数据的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——序列的长度。

输入数据的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——序列中的元素。保证序列中的所有元素互不相同。

## 输出格式

第一行输出满足要求时，原序列最多可以划分成的子序列数量 $*k*$。

接下来的 $*k*$ 行按照以下格式输出子序列的描述：先输出子序列中的元素个数 $*c*_{*i*}$（$0 < *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），然后输出 $*c*_{*i*}$ 个整数 $*l*_{1}, *l*_{2}, ..., *l*_{*c*_{*i*}}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$）——这些元素在原序列中的下标。

下标可以按任意顺序输出。$1$ 到 $*n*$ 的每个下标必须在输出中**恰好出现一次**。

如果有多种可行答案，输出任意一种即可。

## 说明

在第一个样例的输出中：

对第一个子序列进行排序后，将得到序列 $1 2 3 6 5 4$。

对第二个子序列进行排序不会改变任何内容。

对第三个子序列进行排序后，将得到序列 $1 2 3 4 5 6$。

对最后一个子序列进行排序不会改变任何内容。
